{
  "title": "Tactical Situational Awareness System (TSAS) Logical Architecture",
  "design_rationale": "The architecture adopts a modular service-oriented design centered around an internal Pub/Sub messaging backbone to satisfy the mandatory requirement for component communication and degraded mode operation. By decoupling ingestion from processing, the system ensures that high-volume video streams and GPS pings do not block critical alert handling or map updates. A dedicated fusion layer normalizes heterogeneous inputs into a single canonical model, enabling efficient sensor fusion and unified geospatial visualization. The separation of 'Command Post Core' services from 'Field Edge' gateways allows for independent scaling and resilience; if the link to the field degrades, the command post continues to operate using cached state and queued messages. Offline capabilities are pushed to the mobile client via pre-loaded tile caches, ensuring map functionality without internet. Security is enforced at every boundary with mutual TLS and role-based access control, while all persistent data remains on-premises to meet strict compliance requirements. Position history is now explicitly managed by the Map Visualization Service to support playback and stale position display, leveraging its existing spatial index.",
  "components": [
    {
      "id": "C-EDGE-GW",
      "name": "Field Edge Gateway",
      "kind": "gateway",
      "subsystem": "Field Edge",
      "trust_zone": "field",
      "purpose": "Aggregates GPS, telemetry, and emergency signals from SAM devices and cellular apps; handles local buffering for intermittent connectivity.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.COMMS.DEGRADED",
        "CAP.SEC.ENCRYPT"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Authenticate field devices via mutual TLS",
        "Buffer position updates during link outages",
        "Forward telemetry to Command Post Core",
        "Relay alerts and push notifications to field devices"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "GPS/Telemetry from SAM Devices",
        "Position Reports from Cellular Apps",
        "Emergency Signals from SAM Devices"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Normalized Position Stream",
        "Device Status Updates",
        "Alert Ingestion Events"
      ],
      "data_owned": [],
      "dependencies": [
        "C-MESSAGING",
        "C-DEVICE-MGMT"
      ],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "Field devices support standard cellular or satellite links",
        "Link latency can vary significantly (TBD)"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Deployed on ruggedized edge hardware or cloud-edge hybrid nodes",
        "Must handle concurrent connections for battalion-sized units"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "High availability in field conditions",
        "Low latency forwarding when link is available"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Supports proprietary SAM device protocols",
        "Supports standard HTTP/MQTT for cellular apps"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-FT-01",
        "SL-COM-02",
        "SL-AL-01",
        "SL-AL-03",
        "SL-NF-05",
        "SL-SEC-02"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "Edge gateway does not perform heavy analytics to conserve power/bandwidth",
        "Local buffer size is sufficient for expected outage durations (TBD)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-MESSAGING",
      "name": "Pub/Sub Messaging Backbone",
      "kind": "service",
      "subsystem": "Command Post Core",
      "trust_zone": "command-post",
      "purpose": "Central asynchronous messaging layer for all inter-component communication, ensuring decoupling and reliability.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.COMMS.MESSAGING"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Route messages between components",
        "Persist messages for replay if needed (TBD)",
        "Ensure at-least-once delivery semantics",
        "Support topic-based filtering"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Messages from C-EDGE-GW",
        "Messages from C-FUSION",
        "Messages from C-VIDEO-PIPE"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Position Updates to C-MAP-SVC",
        "Alerts to C-ALERT-SVC",
        "Fused Tracks to C-MAP-SVC"
      ],
      "data_owned": [],
      "dependencies": [],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "High throughput required for video metadata and GPS streams",
        "Must survive individual component restarts without data loss (TBD)"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Clustered deployment for high availability",
        "Runs on Linux containers"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "High throughput",
        "Low latency",
        "Durability"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Standard MQTT or Kafka-like interface",
        "TLS encryption for all connections"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-COM-01",
        "SL-NF-02"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "Message payload size is small for GPS/Alerts, large for Video Metadata",
        "Backpressure handling is implemented at the producer level"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-FUSION",
      "name": "Sensor Fusion & Normalization Engine",
      "kind": "service",
      "subsystem": "Command Post Core",
      "trust_zone": "command-post",
      "purpose": "Normalizes heterogeneous inputs into a common data model and fuses multiple sources (GPS, EO detections) into unified tracks.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.FUSION.NORMALIZE",
        "CAP.FUSION.FUSE"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Normalize GPS positions from SAM devices and apps",
        "Normalize EO detections into geo-referenced objects",
        "Correlate GPS tracks with EO detections",
        "Deduplicate tracks",
        "Assign unique persistent IDs to units/objects"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Normalized Positions from C-EDGE-GW",
        "Detections from C-VIDEO-PIPE"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Unified Track Picture",
        "Geo-referenced Detections"
      ],
      "data_owned": [],
      "dependencies": [
        "C-MESSAGING"
      ],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "Temporal alignment of GPS and Video metadata is possible (TBD)",
        "Spatial reference systems are consistent"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Stateful service requiring shared memory or database for track history",
        "GPU acceleration not strictly required but beneficial for correlation logic"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "Accuracy of fusion",
        "Low processing latency"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Must understand canonical data model schema",
        "Must handle out-of-order messages"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-SF-01",
        "SL-SF-02",
        "SL-EO-07",
        "SL-FT-01"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "GPS positions are the ground truth for unit location; EO detections are supplementary",
        "Track ID persistence survives system restarts (TBD)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-MAP-SVC",
      "name": "Map Visualization Service",
      "kind": "service",
      "subsystem": "Command Post Core",
      "trust_zone": "command-post",
      "purpose": "Manages map state, layers, geofences, and route planning data; serves map tiles and dynamic objects to clients. Stores position history for playback and stale position handling.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.MAP.LAYERS",
        "CAP.TRACK.GEOFENCE",
        "CAP.ROUTE.COMPUTE",
        "CAP.TRACK.HISTORY",
        "CAP.TRACK.POSITION.STALE"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Store and serve base map tiles (including offline cache metadata)",
        "Manage geofence definitions and evaluate unit positions against them",
        "Compute routes considering terrain and no-go areas",
        "Estimate ETA based on current position and route",
        "Serve dynamic layer data (units, detections) to clients",
        "Persist full position history for playback (SL-FT-02)",
        "Calculate and display stale position age (SL-FT-03)"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Unified Track Picture from C-FUSION",
        "Geofence Definitions from C-CONFIG",
        "Route Requests from Clients"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Map State Updates to Clients",
        "Geofence Violation Alerts",
        "Computed Routes and ETAs",
        "Position History Playback Data"
      ],
      "data_owned": [
        "DS-MAP-TILES",
        "DS-GEOFENCES",
        "DS-POSITION-HISTORY"
      ],
      "dependencies": [
        "C-MESSAGING",
        "C-FUSION"
      ],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "Terrain data is available and pre-loaded",
        "Geofence evaluation can be done efficiently in memory or via spatial index",
        "Position history storage scales linearly with unit count and time (TBD)"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Runs on Linux servers",
        "May require significant RAM for large map datasets",
        "Requires persistent storage for position history"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "Low latency for position updates",
        "High availability",
        "Efficient historical query performance"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Must support standard map tile formats (e.g., MBTiles, XYZ)",
        "Must expose REST/gRPC API for route computation and history playback",
        "Must persist position updates asynchronously"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-MAP-01",
        "SL-FT-04",
        "SL-RT-01",
        "SL-RT-02",
        "SL-NF-01",
        "SL-FT-02",
        "SL-FT-03",
        "SL-NF-03"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "Offline map tiles are pre-cached on the client side; server only serves metadata and dynamic objects",
        "Geofence checks are triggered by position updates, not continuous polling",
        "Position history is stored in a time-series optimized format within DS-POSITION-HISTORY"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-VIDEO-PIPE",
      "name": "Video Analytics Pipeline",
      "kind": "pipeline",
      "subsystem": "Command Post Core",
      "trust_zone": "command-post",
      "purpose": "Ingests live video, performs object detection/classification/tracking, and outputs geo-referenced detections.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.VIDEO.INGEST",
        "CAP.VIDEO.ANALYTICS",
        "CAP.VIDEO.TRACKING",
        "CAP.PLATFORM.GPU"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [
        "CAP.VIDEO.SEMANTIC",
        "CAP.VIDEO.CHANGE",
        "CAP.VIDEO.CAPTION"
      ],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Ingest RTSP-like video streams from EO sensors",
        "Record video to local storage",
        "Run AI models for person/vehicle detection and classification",
        "Track objects across frames and assign track IDs",
        "Geo-reference detections using sensor metadata",
        "Publish detections to the messaging backbone"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Live Video Streams from EO Sensors",
        "Sensor Metadata (Camera Pose, Calibration)"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Recorded Video Files",
        "Geo-referenced Detections"
      ],
      "data_owned": [
        "DS-VIDEO-RECORDINGS"
      ],
      "dependencies": [
        "C-MESSAGING"
      ],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "GPU hardware is available and accessible",
        "Video streams are stable and authenticated",
        "Sensor calibration data is accurate and up-to-date"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Deployed on GPU-enabled Linux servers",
        "Containerized for easy scaling of analytics workers"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "High throughput (FPS)",
        "Low inference latency",
        "Accuracy of detection/tracking"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Must support standard video codecs",
        "Must output detections in canonical format"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-EO-01",
        "SL-EO-02",
        "SL-EO-03",
        "SL-EO-04",
        "SL-EO-05",
        "SL-EO-06",
        "SL-NF-04"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "Video ingestion and analytics are decoupled to allow independent scaling",
        "Geo-referencing is done at the pipeline level using known camera positions"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-ALERT-SVC",
      "name": "Alert Management Service",
      "kind": "service",
      "subsystem": "Command Post Core",
      "trust_zone": "command-post",
      "purpose": "Manages alert lifecycle, including emergency alerts, device status warnings, and geofence violations; handles acknowledgements.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.ALERT.EMERGENCY",
        "CAP.ALERT.ACKNOWLEDGE",
        "CAP.ALERT.DEVICE_STATUS"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Receive and prioritize emergency alerts",
        "Monitor device status (battery, radio, water)",
        "Process geofence violation events from C-MAP-SVC",
        "Route alerts to appropriate operators/apps",
        "Track alert acknowledgement status"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Emergency Signals from C-EDGE-GW",
        "Device Status from C-DEVICE-MGMT",
        "Geofence Violations from C-MAP-SVC"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Alert Notifications to Clients",
        "Acknowledgement Updates"
      ],
      "data_owned": [
        "DS-ALERTS"
      ],
      "dependencies": [
        "C-MESSAGING",
        "C-DEVICE-MGMT",
        "C-MAP-SVC"
      ],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "Alert priority levels are well-defined",
        "Acknowledgement latency is critical for emergency alerts"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "High availability required",
        "Must integrate with push notification service"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "Low latency for emergency alerts",
        "Reliability of delivery"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Must support push notification protocols",
        "Must interface with mobile apps for acknowledgement"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-AL-01",
        "SL-AL-02",
        "SL-AL-03",
        "SL-FT-04"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "Alerts are stored persistently for audit and review",
        "Push notification service is abstracted behind this component"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-DEVICE-MGMT",
      "name": "Device Management Service",
      "kind": "service",
      "subsystem": "Command Post Core",
      "trust_zone": "command-post",
      "purpose": "Manages device registry, time synchronization, and health monitoring for SAM devices and SW-Watches.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.DEVICE.SYNC"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Maintain registry of all field devices",
        "Distribute time synchronization signals",
        "Aggregate device health metrics (battery, radio)",
        "Authenticate devices during connection"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Device Telemetry from C-EDGE-GW",
        "Time Sync Requests from Devices"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Device Status Updates",
        "Time Sync Commands"
      ],
      "data_owned": [
        "DS-DEVICE-REGISTRY"
      ],
      "dependencies": [
        "C-MESSAGING"
      ],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "Devices have basic clock capabilities",
        "Time sync frequency is low (e.g., hourly)"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Runs as a lightweight service",
        "Integrates with NTP or proprietary time source"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "Accuracy of time synchronization",
        "Reliability of registry"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Must support secure time distribution",
        "Must interface with C-EDGE-GW for telemetry"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-AL-04",
        "SL-AL-03"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "Device registry is updated in real-time via messaging",
        "Time sync is not critical for GPS accuracy (GPS provides time)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-DIARY-SVC",
      "name": "Operator Diary Service",
      "kind": "service",
      "subsystem": "Command Post Core",
      "trust_zone": "command-post",
      "purpose": "Manages creation, storage, and search of operator diary entries linked to units, tracks, or map locations.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.DIARY.RECORD",
        "CAP.DIARY.SEARCH"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Accept diary entries from clients",
        "Link entries to entities (units, tracks, locations)",
        "Index entries for full-text and temporal search",
        "Serve search results to clients"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Diary Entries from Clients",
        "Entity Metadata from C-FUSION"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Search Results",
        "Entry Details"
      ],
      "data_owned": [
        "DS-DIARY"
      ],
      "dependencies": [
        "C-MESSAGING"
      ],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "Search queries are not extremely complex",
        "Diary entries are relatively small text blobs"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Uses a search-optimized database (e.g., Elasticsearch-like)",
        "Runs on Linux containers"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "Search latency",
        "Data retention compliance"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Must support structured and unstructured search",
        "Must integrate with mobile app for entry submission"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-OD-01",
        "SL-OD-02",
        "INF-02"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "Diary entries are immutable once submitted (audit trail)",
        "Search index is updated asynchronously"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-AUDIT-SVC",
      "name": "Audit & Compliance Service",
      "kind": "service",
      "subsystem": "Command Post Core",
      "trust_zone": "command-post",
      "purpose": "Captures all operator actions and system alerts for tamper-evident logging.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.SEC.AUDIT"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Log all user authentication events",
        "Log all critical operator actions (e.g., sending alerts, modifying geofences)",
        "Log system alerts and their lifecycle",
        "Ensure log integrity (hash chaining or similar)"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Audit Events from C-ALERT-SVC",
        "Audit Events from C-DIARY-SVC",
        "Audit Events from C-MAP-SVC"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Tamper-Evident Audit Logs"
      ],
      "data_owned": [
        "DS-AUDIT-LOGS"
      ],
      "dependencies": [],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "Audit logs are write-once",
        "Log storage is separate from operational data"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Runs on Linux servers",
        "May use append-only file system or blockchain-like structure"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "Integrity of logs",
        "Immutability"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Must receive events from all critical services",
        "Must support secure log export for review"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-SEC-04"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "Audit logging does not block operational workflows (async)",
        "Log retention period is defined by policy (TBD)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-MOBILE-APP",
      "name": "Cellular Team Leader App",
      "kind": "client_app",
      "subsystem": "Mobile",
      "trust_zone": "mobile",
      "purpose": "Provides map visualization, position reporting, diary entry submission, and alert acknowledgement for team leaders.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.MOBILE.APP",
        "CAP.MOBILE.NOTIFY",
        "CAP.MAP.OFFLINE"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Display map with offline tiles",
        "Show own unit and friendly units",
        "Send position reports and diary entries",
        "Receive and display alerts",
        "Acknowledge alerts",
        "Handle push notifications"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Map State Updates from C-MAP-SVC",
        "Alerts from C-ALERT-SVC",
        "Push Notifications"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Position Reports",
        "Diary Entries",
        "Alert Acknowledgements"
      ],
      "data_owned": [],
      "dependencies": [
        "C-MESSAGING",
        "C-ALERT-SVC"
      ],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "Device has GPS capability",
        "Device has cellular connectivity (intermittent)",
        "Pre-loaded map tiles are available"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Runs on iOS/Android devices",
        "App binary is signed and updated via secure channel"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "Battery efficiency",
        "Offline functionality",
        "UI responsiveness"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Must support offline map rendering",
        "Must integrate with OS-level push notification service (or on-prem alternative)"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-APP-01",
        "SL-APP-02",
        "SL-MAP-02",
        "INF-01",
        "INF-02"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "Map tiles are cached locally; app does not fetch them on demand",
        "Position reports are sent via C-EDGE-GW",
        "Push notifications may use a local relay if public cloud is prohibited (see OQ-05)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-COMMAND-UI",
      "name": "Command Post Operator UI",
      "kind": "ui",
      "subsystem": "Command Post Core",
      "trust_zone": "command-post",
      "purpose": "Web-based interface for command post operators to view the full situational picture, manage geofences, and review logs.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.MAP.LAYERS"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Display comprehensive map with all layers",
        "Allow geofence creation/editing",
        "View diary entries and search results",
        "Monitor device status dashboards",
        "Review audit logs (read-only)"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Map State Updates from C-MAP-SVC",
        "Alerts from C-ALERT-SVC",
        "Diary Search Results from C-DIARY-SVC"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Geofence Updates",
        "User Actions"
      ],
      "data_owned": [],
      "dependencies": [
        "C-MAP-SVC",
        "C-ALERT-SVC",
        "C-DIARY-SVC"
      ],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "Browser supports WebGL for map rendering",
        "Stable high-bandwidth connection within command post LAN"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Hosted as static assets served by C-MAP-SVC or separate web server",
        "Runs in modern browsers on Linux workstations"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "High resolution display support",
        "Low latency interaction"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Must consume REST/WebSocket APIs from backend services",
        "Must support role-based UI elements"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-MAP-01",
        "SL-OD-02",
        "SL-AL-03"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "UI is thin client; all logic resides in backend services",
        "Authentication is handled via central auth service (abstracted)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "C-CONFIG-SVC",
      "name": "Configuration & Policy Service",
      "kind": "service",
      "subsystem": "Command Post Core",
      "trust_zone": "command-post",
      "purpose": "Manages system configuration, user roles, permissions, and geofence definitions.",
      "required_capabilities": [
        "CAP.SEC.AUTH"
      ],
      "optional_capabilities": [],
      "responsibilities": [
        "Define and store user roles and permissions",
        "Manage geofence geometries",
        "Configure system parameters (e.g., stale position thresholds)",
        "Distribute configuration updates to clients"
      ],
      "inputs": [
        "Configuration Changes from Operators",
        "User Authentication Requests"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Role/Permission Data",
        "Geofence Definitions",
        "System Config"
      ],
      "data_owned": [
        "DS-CONFIG"
      ],
      "dependencies": [],
      "runtime_assumptions": [
        "Configuration changes are infrequent",
        "Role definitions are hierarchical"
      ],
      "deployment_assumptions": [
        "Runs on Linux servers",
        "Database-backed storage"
      ],
      "quality_constraints": [
        "Consistency of configuration",
        "Security of role data"
      ],
      "integration_requirements": [
        "Must integrate with C-MAP-SVC for geofences",
        "Must integrate with C-ALERT-SVC for alert routing rules"
      ],
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-SEC-03",
        "SL-FT-04"
      ],
      "design_assumptions": [
        "Configuration is versioned",
        "Geofence data is synchronized to C-MAP-SVC periodically or on change"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "interfaces": [
    {
      "id": "IF-01",
      "source": "C-EDGE-GW",
      "target": "C-MESSAGING",
      "name": "Position & Telemetry Ingestion",
      "payload": "JSON: { device_id, lat, lon, timestamp, battery_level }",
      "protocol_candidates": [
        "MQTT",
        "HTTPS POST"
      ],
      "mode": "async",
      "error_handling": "Retry with exponential backoff; buffer locally if messaging layer is down",
      "security": "Mutual TLS, Device Certificate Authentication",
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-FT-01",
        "SL-COM-01"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "IF-02",
      "source": "C-EDGE-GW",
      "target": "C-MESSAGING",
      "name": "Emergency Alert Ingestion",
      "payload": "JSON: { device_id, alert_type: 'EMERGENCY', timestamp }",
      "protocol_candidates": [
        "MQTT (High Priority Topic)",
        "HTTPS POST"
      ],
      "mode": "async",
      "error_handling": "Immediate retry; fallback to SMS if available (TBD)",
      "security": "Mutual TLS, Device Certificate Authentication",
